 Appearance:
MR PREMAL S RACHH, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR.NANDISH H THACKAR, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1

MR KP RAVAL, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE S.G.SHAH  Date : 22/07/2016
ORAL ORDER 1. Rule, returnable on 9.9.2016.
Learned APP waives service of rule for respondent No.1 - State.

2. In the present Criminal Revision Application, the applicant herein original accused has prayed to release him on bail by suspending the sentence imposed by judgment order dated 2.4.2013 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Palitana in Criminal Case No.747 of 1996 as well as the judgment and order dated 14.07.2016 passed by the learned 4th Addl.Sessions Judge,
Bhavnagar in Criminal Appeal No.24 of 2013 rejecting the appeal filed by the present applicant and confirmed the order passed by the learned HC-NIC Page 1 of 3 Created On Tue Jan 24 00:26:56 IST 2017 R/CR.RA/573/2016 ORDER J.M.F.C., Palitana, by which, the applicant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 16 for the offence u/ss.7(i) and 2(ia)(m) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment of one year with fine of Rs.2,000/- and in default, to undergo further R.I of 30 days.

3. Heard learned advocate Mr.Nandish H.Thackar appearing for the applicant and learned APP Mr.K.P.Raval for the respondent - State and perused the record of the case.

sentences.text: Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and sentence imposed by the learned J.M.F.C., Palitana in Criminal Case No.747 of 1996 and confirmed by learned 4th Addl.Sessions Judge, Bhavnagar in Criminal Appeal No.24 of 2013, the present application requires consideration and the same is allowed.

The sentence imposed by judgment and order dated 2.4.2013 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Palitana in Criminal Case No.747 of 1996 as well as the judgment and order dated 14.07.2016 passed by the learned 4th Addl.Sessions Judge, Bhavnagar in Criminal Appeal No.24 of 2013 are hereby suspended.
The applicant shall be released on regular bail on executing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) and one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the HC-NIC Page 2 of 3
Created On Tue Jan 24 00:26:56 IST 2017 R/CR.RA/573/2016 ORDER
Trial Court and subject to the conditions that he shall;

(a) surrender passport, if any, to the lower court within a week;
(b) not leave the State of Gujarat without prior permission of the Trial Court;

(c) furnish the present address of residence to the I.O. and also to the Court at the time of execution of the bond and shall not change the residence without prior permission of this Court;
Direct service is permitted.
( S.G.SHAH
